description:
Create a family of 3 airfoils for a tapered wind turbine blade using QBlade's scaling tools.

1. Generate a baseline NACA 4415 airfoil using the NACA Generator. Name it 'NACA_4415_Base'.

2. Create a thick root airfoil by scaling the baseline to 25% max thickness. Name it 'NACA_4415_Root'.

3. Create a thin tip airfoil by scaling the baseline to 12% max thickness. Name it 'NACA_4415_Tip'.

4. Export all three airfoils as coordinate files (.dat) to the directory '/home/ga/Documents/airfoils/family/' with filenames 'base.dat', 'root.dat', and 'tip.dat'.

5. Save the QBlade project as '/home/ga/Documents/projects/airfoil_family_scaling.wpa'.
